_meta.description: Ship definitions. One ship in the base game — the colony transport. Upgradeable via items in cargo (ship upgrades activate passively while held). Ship stats are set at trail selection, not here. This file is the ship's identity layer: name pool, description, base hull rating, cargo capacity baseline, and sprite reference. The engine reads this at game start to initialize the ship object.
_meta.design_note: There is one ship. The player does not choose it. They are already on it. The ship has a name — generated from name_pool at run start — which the ship computer refers to it by for the entire run. The name is always slightly wrong for what the ship actually is.

ships.name: Colony Transport (Class C)
ships.description: A standard colony-class deep space transport. Rated for long haul. Currently being used for a long haul. The ship computer considers this a reasonable use of the vessel and has said so, in the ship's log, twice.
ships.flavor: Not fast. Not glamorous. Structurally sound in most weather conditions, though 'weather' is doing some work in a vacuum. The growbay takes up 30% of usable interior space. This is intentional. The colony authority prioritized the plants. This was probably the right call.
ships.log_description: Colony transport, Class C. Growbay rated for 5 crop types. Hull: standard deep space spec. FTL capable: yes. FTL reliable: ask at next station.
ships.computer_voice_note: The ship computer was installed by the colony authority. It has opinions about the crop. It has fewer opinions about the crew. It has logged both facts.
